description: Hotels.com provider completion — wire up the existing skeleton to correctly handle URL matching, stage detection, guest form fill, and end-to-end checkout

userStories.title: Fix Expedia provider URL conflict with Hotels.com
userStories.description: As a developer, I need expedia.ts to stop matching hotels.com URLs so the hotels-com provider can handle them exclusively.
acceptanceCriteria: In expedia.ts, matchesUrl() only returns true for expedia.com URLs, NOT hotels.com
expediaProvider.matchesUrl('https://www.hotels.com/search') returns false
expediaProvider.matchesUrl('https://www.expedia.com/Hotel-Search') returns true
hotelsComProvider.matchesUrl('https://www.hotels.com/search') returns true
hotelsComProvider.matchesUrl('https://www.expedia.com/Hotel-Search') returns false
Registry returns hotelsComProvider for hotels.com URLs
Registry returns expediaProvider for expedia.com URLs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: expedia.ts line ~1019: matchesUrl returns true for both expedia.com AND hotels.com — this causes registry ambiguity. hotels-com.ts already exists and delegates to fillExpediaGroupPaymentForm. Just remove hotels.com from expedia's matchesUrl.

userStories.title: Add fillGuestForm to hotels-com provider
userStories.description: As a developer, I need hotels-com.ts to fill the guest form on Hotels.com checkout pages, reusing Expedia's implementation since the checkout infrastructure is shared.
acceptanceCriteria: hotels-com.ts exports hotelsComProvider with fillGuestForm method
fillGuestForm delegates to fillExpediaGuestForm from expedia.ts
fillExpediaGuestForm is exported from expedia.ts (add export if missing)
HotelsComProfile interface includes first_name, last_name, email, phone fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: fillExpediaGuestForm already exists in expedia.ts. Check if it is exported. hotels-com.ts has fillPaymentForm but no fillGuestForm. Hotels.com and Expedia share the same checkout/session URL (expedia.com/checkout/session/) so the same fill logic applies.

userStories.title: Fix hotels-com stage signals for expedia.com checkout redirect
userStories.description: As a developer, I need hotels-com getStageSignals to correctly detect payment_gate when Hotels.com redirects to expedia.com/checkout/session/ for payment.
acceptanceCriteria: paymentStep returns true when URL contains expedia.com/checkout/session (Hotels.com redirects here)
paymentStep returns true when URL contains hotels.com/checkout/session
guestDetailsStep returns true when URL contains /checkout and guest form inputs are visible
guestDetailsStep returns false for /checkout/session URLs (combined page is handled as paymentStep)
searchResults returns true for hotels.com/search URLs
hotelDetail returns true for hotels.com/ho<digits> pattern URLs
hotelDetail returns true for hotels.com/h<digits> pattern URLs (alternate format)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current getStageSignals checks lowerUrl.includes('/checkout/session') for isPaymentSessionUrl — this works for expedia.com but Hotels.com may redirect to expedia.com domain. Also the guestDetailsStep DOM query uses id*='firstName' etc. which doesn't match Expedia's actual IDs (smart-form-control-input-component-trave). Use placeholder-based detection instead: input[placeholder*='John'] or input[type='email'].

userStories.title: Add hotels.com to stagehand-executor provider drift guard
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the executor's provider drift guard to allow Hotels.com → expedia.com checkout redirects, the same way Expedia brand-site redirects are allowed.
acceptanceCriteria: In stagehand-executor.ts, the provider drift guard (checks for unexpected URL domain changes) allows hotels.com URLs to redirect to expedia.com/checkout/session
A Hotels.com booking task does not trigger a false-positive 'provider drift' warning when it reaches the Expedia checkout URL
The expedia provider drift allowlist includes hotels.com as a source domain
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: stagehand-executor.ts has logic to detect when the browser navigates away from the expected provider domain (e.g. Expedia→IHG brand site). Hotels.com→expedia.com/checkout is a legitimate cross-domain redirect that must be allowed. Search for 'drift' or 'provider.*url' or 'matchesUrl' in the executor to find the guard.

userStories.title: End-to-end Hotels.com booking verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to confirm the full Hotels.com automation flow works: listing → room selection → checkout → payment gate with all fields pre-filled.
acceptanceCriteria: Run a booking task targeting a real Hotels.com hotel (e.g. search New York)
Flow completes all stages: listing → room_selection → checkout_form → payment_gate
Guest fields filled: first name, last name, email, phone
Card fields filled: name on card, card number, expiry date
Billing ZIP filled
Status shows 'Ready for payment — enter CVC'
No 'provider drift' or unexpected stage errors in agent log
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Hotels.com uses the same Checkout.com payment widget as Expedia (iframes 19-22 with id=name/payment_credit_card/expiry/payment_cvv_code). The billing ZIP field is id=payment_zip_code. All of these are handled by fillExpediaGroupPaymentForm already. The main risk is stage detection and the expedia.com checkout redirect.
